name: translate-text
description: Translate text (agent messages, support replies, documents) into another language without breaking Markdown, code blocks, URLs, or proper nouns. Single routed x402 call to AgentUtility.ai (USDC via Circle Gateway), auto-detects the source language; optional source_language and formality (casual/formal/neutral).

text.description: The text to translate. Max 12k chars. Used as ${text}.

target_language.description: Target language as an ISO code or name, e.g. 'es' or 'Spanish'. Used as ${target_language}.

steps.label: translate — AgentUtility.ai translate-text (x402 via Circle Gateway)
